fusions.name: Fingerwork
fusions.desc: Flicks a round that deals 4 damage, then bounces to 1 more enemy within 3.5 tiles for 60% of the damage.

fusions.name: Fruit-Pelt Trio
fusions.desc: Throws 3 rounds in a spread; each round deals 5 damage and the last to land leaves the target [Stunned] for 1 second.

fusions.name: Sleeve Trick
fusions.desc: For 8 seconds, each debuff laid on you has a 50% chance to be sent back to its source, which suffers 25% of its strength.

fusions.name: Palmed Round
fusions.desc: Once every 10 seconds, a strike that failed to crit is rolled a second time, and the second roll stands.
